analysis.counting_rule: Caller and external reference counts are unique or raw counts derived from exact joins in the committed xref export; null/unavailable is retained when the identity token cannot be joined.
analysis.interpretation_guardrail: External DLL/API names are treated as identifiers and evidence of external identity only; no gameplay semantics are inferred from them.
analysis.purpose: Read-only enrichment of the exact disjoint external range EXTERNAL:0000016d through EXTERNAL:000001e8 inclusive.

cause_findings.finding: The requested range contains exactly 124 contiguous, unique, external, noncanonical manager entries from the 488-row external-only reconciliation.
The supplied reconciliation exposes no local body size, section, block, or thunk flag; these remain null with explicit not-applicable or unavailable reasons rather than fabricated zero values.
Sixty-nine rows have confirmed external identity tokens and 55 rows have no name or identity token; the latter cannot be joined safely to tokenized xrefs and therefore retain null counts/callsites.

Exact joins to the committed xref export yield 1,619 external reference rows, 759 distinct local caller VAs, and 918 per-entry caller-count sum across the 69 named rows; every named row has at least one committed xref.

The atlas classifies all 124 rows as UNKNOWN category entries at a runtime-or-third-party boundary and leaves gameplay affinity, subsystem, and cluster unknown; API names are not used to infer gameplay behavior.
No selected entry overlaps the canonical VA universe and no duplicate entry occurs in this range; each row is distinct as an external manager identity, not as an established local executable body.
